about_the_game:
Forge an unstoppable army from a range of diverse fighters to fight against the forces of Wrath in this strategic auto-battler. Draft your army to diverse situations, organize your army to attack with force, and watch autonomous battles unfold in a symphony of emergent strategy!

From humble skirmishes to grand-scale warfare, your choices dictate the flow of battle. Every round starts with the preparation phase where you’ll manage your economy, draft new units from the store, reroll and position units. Then follows the explosive combat phase, where your meticulously assembled legions clash with the wave of creatures coming your way.

Your fight spans across multiple challenges, each with their own selection of enemies to fight against. 

Command a legion of unique combatants:

  • Diverse Battalions: Lead groups units, including resilient melee tanks and precise ranged sharpshooters and devastating damage dealers.

  • Branching scenarios: Take on different enemies and challenges to test your tactics.

Expand your dominion with strategic depth:

  • Master the Economy: Amass gold and resources with every win to build your army. Navigate a randomized shop, complete with rerolls and rare units, offering endless strategic pivots.

  • Tactical Positioning: The grid is your canvas! Place your units with foresight, securing formation bonuses, protecting your vital backline, and leveraging terrain and obstacles to outmaneuver your opponent.

Dive into Isles of Wrath: obliterate the enemy, manage your economy and dominate the isles.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 10
  • Processor: Dual Core Processor
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 3000
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 10
  • Processor: Quad Core Processor
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 8600 GT

short_description: Defend your outpost from relentless tides of monsters. Collect and upgrade your army with new units to strategically face ever-expanding forces. Purchase new units to join your ranks and vanquish all foes.
